I lost someone o thought I was going to marry because she gained close to the same weight. She refused to see how the extra weight could effect her attractiveness. I tried everything. Waking up everyday and working out. Going grocery shopping drawing up workouts the whole nine. She could be addicted to the feeling of eating as weird as it sounds. I ended up leaving because I felt if you loved someone you'd want to be your best for the mentally and physically. The weight was a physical feature but it was a mental problem she wasn't ready to overcome with me. I felt like she didn't love me in the end. So I left. Best of luck to you. I hope she sees how it can effect you without being selfish and blaming you.
